labels.justification: The clause restricts data processing of children's data for safety, aligning with the restriction on educational institutions' data processing for tracking and behavioral monitoring.
The clause requires a notice accompanying consent requests, satisfying the requirement for informing Data Principals of processing purposes.
The clause mandates secure processing of personal data, addressing cross-border transfer requirements for data protection.
The clause prohibits ads from stating knowledge of personal data, aligning with breach notification requirements for detailed breach descriptions.
The clause mandates secure processing measures like encryption, aligning with security safeguards requirements.
The clause does not meaningfully address any listed requirement.
